model.name: RbDetailDrawer.applyPosition
model.description: applyPosition(pos: 'inline' | 'bottom'): NEW thin, LOAD-BEARING marked decl on the EXISTING RbDetailDrawer (position=mode, ONE component). Body MINIMAL: set the data-position attr -> CSS branches (inline = position:static in-flow [D] segment / bottom = position:fixed;bottom:0 as today) -> delegate re-fit to the existing ResizeObserver/attributeChangedCallback. data-position added to observedAttributes (reactive). Touches NOTHING in detail-flow/scroll/grab-bar/expand-minimize/in-room-X-chat (unchanged). NOT attr+CSS-only - a real chain node for traceability + consistency with 5.4 applyViewportMode. Expert places [impl:uuid] on the applyPosition decl (#126). AC-INV-PRESENTATION (R31.5.8) + HARD AC (no 2nd full-width-drawer component) gate it. R31.5.7, architect topology ce65c672a. DRIVER (architect confirm): applyPosition is driven by the SAME container-query as 5.4 (rb-strip data-mode) so data-position flips inline<->bottom WITH landscape<->portrait — landscape/wide = inline (the drawer is the [D] strip segment, position:static in-flow, sized by the strip); portrait/narrow = bottom (position:fixed;bottom:0 as today). app.css: rb-detail-drawer[data-position=inline]{position:static} vs [data-position=bottom]{position:fixed;bottom:0}. Continues the R31.4 DRY drawer fix (step-0) generalized to POSITION. Confirmed carries the architect method-body spec.
